DEATHKNIGHT_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Deathknight when:

  • Their major damage cooldowns Pillar of Frost and Empower Rune Weapon are active or about to be activated.
  • They enter their primary burst damage window, typically aligned with Obliteration phase or Breath of Sindragosa uptime.
  • Their rotation reaches peak resource generation during Rime or Killing Machine procs for maximum spell synergy.
DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • Gargoyle is active (and has ≤22 seconds remaining) or
  • Army of the Dead is talented and their Abomination/Army Ghouls are active with <18 seconds remaining or
  • Dark Transformation is active and they haven’t taken Gargoyle/Army talents or
  • They can’t summon Gargoyle soon (if its cooldown +10s exceeds Power Infusion’s duration) or
  • 3+ enemies are active with either Dark Transformation active or enemies standing in Death and Decay
DEMONHUNTER_HAVOC:
Use Power Infusion on the Havoc Demonhunter when:

  • they are under the effects of Metamorphosis, enhancing their burst window during this transformative state
  • the encounter is within 20 seconds of ending, maximizing final damage output before combat concludes
DRUID_BALANCE:
Use Power Infusion on the Balance Druid when:

  • The Druid’s cooldown window is active and they do not have the TWW Keeper 4-piece tier set.
  • They have the TWW Keeper 4-piece tier set and Celestial Alignment meets the required timing conditions (e.g., during its enhanced phase with active stacks or buffs).
DRUID_FERAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Feral Druid when:

  • They activate Incarnation: King of the Jungle (if using the Berserk: Heart of the Lion talent).
  • They do NOT have the Berserk: Heart of the Lion talent and are using Berserk.
EVOKER_DEVASTATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Devastation Evoker when:

  • Their Dragonrage buff is active AND Shattering Star is on cooldown
  • Their Dragonrage buff is active AND the target has a Shattering Star debuff
  • Their Dragonrage buff is active AND there are 2 or more enemies
  • Less than 35 seconds remain in the fight
HUNTER_MARKSMANSHIP:
Use Power Infusion on the Marksmanship Hunter when:

  • Trueshot has more than 12 seconds remaining (to amplify its full burst window)
  • The encounter will end within 13 seconds (to maximize value before downtime)
HUNTER_SURVIVAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Survival Hunter when:

  • Coordinated Assault is active with more than 7 seconds remaining and Power Infusion isn’t already active.
  • The hunter has not talented Coordinated Assault and Spearhead is on cooldown.
  • The hunter has neither talented Coordinated Assault nor Spearhead, regardless of other conditions.
MAGE_ARCANE:
Use Power Infusion on the Arcane Mage when:

  • Their Arcane Surge was the ability immediately cast before this global cooldown.
MAGE_FIRE:
Use Power Infusion on the Fire Mage when:

  • Power Infusion is not active on the target, and they have either:
  • At least 6 seconds remaining on their Combustion buff (to maximize its synergy with this critical damage window),
  • Or the encounter will end within 25 seconds (to ensure the cooldown isn’t wasted before the fight concludes).
MAGE_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Mage when:

  • The mage does not currently have an active Power Infusion buff.
MONK_WINDWALKER:
Use Power Infusion on the Windwalker Monk when:

  • Xuen the White Tiger is active and Bloodlust is not active.
  • Xuen the White Tiger is active and Bloodlust is active, but Strike of the Windlord is still on cooldown.
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when:

  • Voidform is active, Dark Ascension is active, or the TWW 2-piece set bonus is equipped
  • Power Infusion is not already active on the target
ROGUE_ASSASSINATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Assassination Rogue when:

  • Their Deathmark bleed effect is active on the target, enhancing their burst window damage.
ROGUE_SUBTLETY:
Use Power Infusion on the Subtlety Rogue when:

  • The Rogue has Shadow Dance active (indicating they’re entering a burst damage window).
SHAMAN_ELEMENTAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Elemental Shaman when:

  • The Shaman’s Ascendance is active, maximizing burst damage synergy.
  • Ascendance’s cooldown has over 30 seconds remaining, ensuring it won’t interfere with future cooldown alignment.
SHAMAN_ENHANCEMENT:
Use Power Infusion on the Enhancement Shaman when:

  • Ascendance has over 7.5 seconds remaining and they have the Deeply Rooted Elements talent.
  • Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds are active without Deeply Rooted Elements.
  • The fight will end within 20 seconds of the next 2-minute interval (e.g., during execute phases).
  • All their major cooldowns have at least 120 seconds remaining until available.
  • They lack talents for Ascendance, Feral Spirit, Doom Winds entirely.
WARLOCK_AFFLICTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Affliction Warlock when:

  • They activate Soul Rot, their primary damage window ability.
  • Other major cooldowns like Darkglare or Summon Soulkeeper are active, indicating a burst phase.
WARLOCK_DEMONOLOGY:
Use Power Infusion on the Demonology Warlock when:

  • The Warlock’s Wild Imps are active and will despawn within 6 global cooldowns plus cast time remaining in combat.
  • Their imps’ despawn timer aligns with a burst window to maximize Power Infusion haste benefits during their peak damage phase.
WARLOCK_DESTRUCTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Destruction Warlock when:

  • The warlock’s Infernal is currently active and dealing damage.
  • The warlock does not have the Summon Infernal talent selected.
  • The encounter will end before another Summon Infernal can be cast, and there’s enough time remaining to fully benefit from Power Infusion’s duration.
  • The encounter will end within 15 seconds of Summon Infernal’s next cooldown availability (to avoid wasting the buff).
WARRIOR_ARMS:
Use Power Infusion on the Arms Warrior when:

  • They have the Colossus Smash debuff active on the target and the fight will last at least 135 more seconds.
  • They are in the Execute Phase (target below 20% health) and have Avatar active.
  • The fight will end in 25 seconds or less to ensure the full duration is utilized.
WARRIOR_FURY:
Use Power Infusion on the Fury Warrior when:

  • Avatar has over 15 seconds remaining and the encounter duration is 135 seconds or longer.
  • The target is in Execute Phase (below 20% health) while Avatar is active.
  • The encounter will end within 25 seconds, regardless of other cooldowns.
